fewShots.question: How many devices are online right now?
fewShots.query: silver_telemetry | where ingest_time > ago(1d) | summarize last_ingest = max(ingest_time) by device_id | summarize devices = count(), devices_online = countif(last_ingest > ago(20m))

fewShots.question: Which sites are offline?
fewShots.query: silver_telemetry | where device_type == 'gateway' and ingest_time > ago(7d) | summarize last_seen = max(ingest_time) by site_id | where last_seen < ago(20m) | extend minutes_offline = datetime_diff('minute', now(), last_seen) | lookup kind=leftouter (dim_site | project site_id, region) on site_id | order by minutes_offline desc

fewShots.question: Which open alerts are critical?
fewShots.query: silver_alerts | summarize arg_max(event_time, *) by alert_id | where event_type == 'raised' and severity == 'Critical' | project event_time, site_id, device_id, alert_code, message

fewShots.question: Top 5 sites by energy produced in the last 7 days
fewShots.query: silver_telemetry | where device_type == 'inverter' and event_time > ago(7d) | summarize take_any(*) by event_id | summarize avg_kw = avg(pv_kw) by site_id, bin(event_time, 15m) | summarize pv_kwh = round(sum(avg_kw) * 0.25, 1) by site_id | lookup kind=leftouter (dim_site | project site_id, region) on site_id | top 5 by pv_kwh
